cohort: 97 neonates with sepsis (cases) and 194 neonates without sepsis (controls) admitted to neonatal intensive care units of public hospitals in Southeast Ethiopia in 2020
finding: Spontaneous vaginal delivery, birth attended by a traditional birth attendant, history of STI/UTI, intrapartum fever, low APGAR score at 5 minutes, neonatal resuscitation, and low birth weight were identified as independent risk factors for neonatal sepsis.
mod_finding: Spontaneous vaginal delivery was identified as an independent risk factor for neonatal sepsis.
